policy_name: FY2023 NDAA, Section 11227 ("Review of artificial intelligence applications and establishment of performance metrics")
question: What specific criteria will be used to define and measure 'artificial intelligence modernization activities' in the Coast Guard, as mandated by Section 11227(b)(2)?
answer_low_temp:
The specific criteria to define and measure 'artificial intelligence modernization activities' in the Coast Guard, as mandated by Section 11227(b)(2) of the Act, include:

1. Assessment of investment in artificial intelligence innovation, science, and technology, and research and development (Section 11227(b)(2)(A)).
2. Assessment of investment in test and evaluation of artificial intelligence capabilities (Section 11227(b)(2)(B)).
3. Assessment of the integration of, and the resources necessary to better use, artificial intelligence in wargames, exercises, and experimentation (Section 11227(b)(2)(C)).
4. Assessment of the application of, and the resources necessary to better use, artificial intelligence in logistics and sustainment systems (Section 11227(b)(2)(D)).
5. Assessment of the integration of, and the resources necessary to better use, artificial intelligence for administrative functions (Section 11227(b)(2)(E)).
6. Establishment of performance objectives and accompanying metrics for artificial intelligence modernization activities of the Coast Guard (Section 11227(b)(2)(F)).
7. Identification of the resources necessary to effectively use artificial intelligence to carry out the missions of the Coast Guard (Section 11227(b)(2)(G)).

Source: Coast Guard Authorization Act of 2018, Section 11227.
